S0042.reason: We perform the multiplication in Z_8[x], reducing coefficients modulo 8 at each step: (4x - 5)(2x^2 - 4x + 2) = 8x^3 - 16x^2 + 8x - 10x^2 + 20x - 10 = 8x^3 - 26x^2 + 28x - 10.  Then, reduce coefficients: 8x^3 becomes 0x^3, -26x^2 becomes 2x^2, 28x becomes 4x, and -10 becomes 6.
